cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Stay for the Result
cards.instruction: Keep them present until the contest, bargain, or consequence reaches an undeniable outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, read the final dinner bill with me. I taught you to check the total before walking away from the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're quicker at offering a split now. First find the line for that 'just a starter' you ordered. Read the price aloud.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll pay my share. I don't need a lesson.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then show me you can total those lines without me. Stay until we both have the same number; you can transfer it later.
